## What's new

- **Print Screen captures by default.** The default capture shortcut is now **Print Screen** (history: **Ctrl+Print Screen**). Installs still using the old Ctrl+Shift+X default are moved to Print Screen automatically once; a shortcut you picked yourself is kept.
- **No more white window on first launch.** Settings now appears only after it has finished drawing, so it opens with the right colors instead of a blank white window.

> On Windows 11, Print Screen opens Snipping Tool by default. Turn it off in **Settings › Accessibility › Keyboard › "Use the Print screen key to open screen capture"** — KeepShot's Settings window reminds you if it is still on.

> The installer is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may warn about an unknown publisher. Choose **More info → Run anyway**.
